facts.fact: The World Bank's World Development Indicators list 2012 as the year of Niger's latest population census.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Demographic and Health Survey 2017 as Niger's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Core Welfare Indicator Questionnaire Survey (CWIQ)/Priority survey (PS), 2014, as the source of Niger's most recent income and expenditure data.
